Initial release of Advisor skill.

- Provides balanced, objective advice on major decisions in business, finance, career, and life.
- Supports users with second opinions, pros and cons analysis, and surfacing blind spots.
- Encourages thoughtful decision-making with clarifying questions and honest risk assessments.
- Offers clear recommendations while respecting user autonomy.
